دُوَّارَةٌ and ↓ دَوَّارَةٌ , of the head, A round part or portion. (M, K.) ―
-b2- And of the belly, What winds, or what has, or assumes, a coiled, or circular, form, (مَا تَحَوَّى, [so in the M and L, in the K مايَحْوِى, which is evidently a mistake,]) of the guts, or intestines, of a sheep or goat. (M, L, K. *) ―
-b3- Accord. to IAar, (T,) ↓ دَوَّارَةٌ and فَوَّارَةٌ are applied to Anything [round] that does not move nor turn round: and دُوَّارَةٌ and فُوَّارَةٌ to a thing that moves and turns round. (T, K, TA.) ―
-b4- See also دَوَّارَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
